articles.title: Lost Royal Treasures Resurface: How Hidden Crowns Are Rewriting Central European History
articles.summary: Two spectacular hoards of medieval royal regalia—including the only surviving crown of its kind—have emerged from hiding in Poland and Lithuania. The Vilnius Treasure, lost since 1939, was found in 2024 wrapped in newspaper. These artifacts reveal the shared dynastic history of Central Europe.

articles.title: Ghostly Halos Revealed: MIT Scientists Map the Universe's Missing Matter
articles.summary: Using thousands of fast radio bursts, researchers have mapped enormous clouds of diffuse matter surrounding galaxies. This "missing" baryonic matter—long predicted but elusive—extends far beyond galaxies, suggesting black hole and supernova activity is more energetic than previously thought.

articles.title: Sealed for 250 Years: Inside America's High-Tech Time Capsule for the 500th Birthday
articles.summary: On July 4, 2026, a virtually indestructible time capsule will be buried near Independence Hall. Packed with artifacts from all 50 states—a diamond, an AI prediction, a Civil War eagle feather—it's engineered to survive until 2276, when the nation turns 500.
